title: Indicator Seasons — non-blocking review follow-up from PR #159
description: Non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's review of PR #159 (backend-indicator-seasons), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so it isn't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: frontend/src/pages/PortfolioPage.test.tsx's 'adds a new position end to end and reflects it in the refreshed table' test times out (default 5000ms) whenever the full frontend suite is run with `--coverage` (v8 instrumentation overhead pushes it past the timeout) -- reproduced twice during this PR's review, though this PR touches no frontend logic (only the generated api/types.ts). Passes reliably in isolation, on a coverage-less full run, and on a coverage run with the timeout bumped (`--testTimeout=15000`). Not caused by this PR -- pr-decision's notes on at least two prior PRs (backend-indicator-rsi, frontend-trade-journal) already independently observed the identical flake -- but it has now recurred often enough across reviews that it's worth either raising this one test's own timeout or investigating why coverage instrumentation makes it this much slower, rather than each reviewer re-diagnosing it as 'a pre-existing flake' from scratch every time.
